name: Mantle of the Inheritor
body:
Mantle of the Inheritor (Su) [Iomedae]
Source Mythic Origins pg. 7
As a swift action, you can expend one use of mythic power to automatically rid yourself of any one disease, fear, or poison effect affecting you. As a standard action, you can expend one use of mythic power to rid an ally within 30 feet of an effect of one of these types.
